result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a loading spinner is stuck on top of an already-loaded restaurant image, a restaurant name is truncated without ellipsis at the screen edge, and a category chip is cut off awkwardly.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the image appears fully loaded, suggesting a stuck/orphaned loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner is removed once the image finishes loading, or add a timeout/error fallback so the loader never persists over rendered content.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped at the screen edge without an ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Truncate the title with an ellipsis within its card width, or add right-edge padding/fade to visually indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge showing only a small sliver of the pill, which looks like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Show a larger visible portion of the next chip or add an edge fade/gradient to signal that the chip row scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is cropped mid-image with its '-20%' badge visible but no title/metadata, which can appear incomplete if scrolling affordance isn't obvious.
issues.suggestion: This may just be scroll cutoff; if the layout is intended, ensure sufficient content peeks below the fold and verify the card renders fully on scroll.
